title: No test checks what a member sees after the gym removes them
what: When the gym takes a member off in the admin app, the phone should drop to the join screen with the note 'This phone is no longer joined to the gym.' and keep the member's workouts. No test drives that: the note, the old membership card going away, the workouts staying, and the note going once the member joins again are all unchecked. The only test near it checks the gym colours stay mid-use.
expected: A test that makes the gym drop the phone and checks the join screen with its note, no old card, workouts kept, and the note gone after a new join.
how_often: every time a gym removes a member
fix_line: Add a phone test that removes the member on the server and checks the join screen, its note and the kept workouts

title: No test taps Start, See exercises or New routine twice, or starts a workout while the phone is busy
what: The Workout tab must never start two workouts, stack two workout screens, open two previews or make two new routines from a fast double tap, and a start that fails while the phone's database is busy must say 'Couldn't start the workout' and leave nothing half made. No test does any of this. The only start-failed words tested are the widget's.
expected: Tests that double-tap Start, See exercises and New routine and check one result each, and one that makes the start fail and checks the message, no half-made workout and a working Start button.
how_often: every fast double tap or busy phone
fix_line: Add tests that double-tap the Workout tab's buttons and make a start fail
